name: Sheepshead
summary: A 5-player trick-taking partnership game with 32 cards where a picker takes the blind and secretly calls an ace for a hidden partner.
rules_text: Use 32 cards: 7-A in all suits. Queens, Jacks and all Diamonds are trump, ranked Qc Qs Qh Qd Js Jc Jh Jd Ad Td Kd 9d 8d 7d. Other cards rank A T K 9 8 7 in clubs, spades, hearts as fail suits. Point values: A=11, T=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2, others 0, total 120. Deal 6 cards each in 3-2-3 pattern with 2 cards as the blind. Clockwise from left of dealer, each may take the blind or pass; picker adds blind to hand then discards 2 facedown to own pile. Picker normally calls a fail Ace they do not hold from a fail suit they do hold to choose a hidden partner; holder of that Ace is partner. If picker holds all three fail Aces they call a fail Ten. Picker may go alone. Left of dealer leads first trick. Must follow suit of lead; trump is its own suit. If void in led fail suit, must play trump if able. Highest trump wins a trump trick, otherwise highest card of led fail suit wins. Winner leads next. After 6 tricks, picker+partner need 61 points to win; alternative scores for schneider and taking all tricks.
rating_reason: Trick-taking Sheepshead, 5-player, strategic hidden hands and scoring.
